decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch within the firm’s established dumper business that still had its own webpage in 2024, it reflects visible commitment and sunk engineering and marketing effort, so management is likely to continue it despite limited reported results.

This articulated construction dumper builds on the core offer and remained prominently presented in 2024, so an escalation-of-commitment logic and the growing machinery market both favor keeping it on the market.

Although the firm initially invested enough to launch it on its own page, its move to only a website mention in 2024 and its distance from the established range make it the product most likely to be abandoned once disappointing prospects can no longer be treated as temporary.
The compact telescopic loader is close to the firm’s existing strengths and still had a dedicated page in 2024, indicating ongoing commitment that management is unlikely to reverse quickly.
This product is close to the existing business and was supported by a clearly positive market signal in 2024 through a large order and strong rental popularity, making withdrawal very unlikely.

Even though it is distant from the traditional offer, the firm gave it a dedicated page and highlighted strong early operating performance, so sunk development effort plus encouraging evidence make continued support the likely choice.
